Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the contract signature — excited to get StarNorth live. Before we turn on billing I want to confirm a few items for our AP setup so your payments process is smooth:

1) Preferred invoice delivery: do you want invoices emailed to ap@starnorth-energy.com, uploaded to your supplier portal, or routed via a third-party billing system (Bill.com / Tipalti)?

2) Payment rails: will StarNorth pay via ACH (domestic) or wire transfers? If ACH, can you share your company bank details form or the portal field set you require (bank name, routing, account, account type)? If wires, do you require intermediary bank info and SWIFT/IBAN?

3) Remittance: which remit email should we populate on invoices so your team can automatically match payments? If you have an auto-remit / invoice reference format, please paste one sample.

4) PO & terms: Confirm whether StarNorth requires a PO number on every invoice and your standard payment terms (NET30/NET45/NET60) and if partial payments are accepted.

I’ve attached our W9 and the vendor onboarding form for your AP team to review. If it helps, we can set a quick 20-min call with your AP folks to run through the fields.

Best,
Ben Carter

Hi Ben —

Thanks — quick answers below to get us unblocked:

• Invoice delivery: Email to ap@starnorth-energy.com is preferred. We can also accept uploads to our Coupa supplier portal but that requires a separate supplier code — happy to do email for first month while portal is provisioned.

• Payment rails: ACH is preferred for domestic invoices. For first payment (if above $75k) treasury sometimes requests a wire; please include wire fields on invoice as a fallback.

• Remittance: Please set remittance to remits@starnorth-energy.com and include the PO number and our invoice reference format: SN-INV-{YYYY}{6-digit-seq}. Example: SN-INV-202608-001234.

• PO & terms: We require PO on all invoices. Standard terms are NET45. We can support partial payments for milestone invoices with prior approval from procurement.

Also, before ACH setup our treasury team will need: a completed bank authorization form, a scanned voided check or bank letter, and the vendor W9. I see you attached the W9 — could you send the voided check or bank letter and complete the onboarding form fields labeled “bank details” and “tax ID confirmation”?

Happy to hop on a 20-min call tomorrow if that speeds things up — Daniel (cc) owns supplier onboarding and can scope the portal work.

Best,
Olivia Nash
Director, Procurement | StarNorth Energy
